_note: The domain negative case: when no verifiable contact exists, the slot is left empty. The protocol forbids deducing a LinkedIn URL from a person's name, so an unverifiable contact is dropped rather than constructed. No contact data appears here - only the counts.

_provenance.produced_by: aggregate scan of protocol 08 across fully-enriched leads

the_rule.verbatim_intent: only LinkedIn URLs seen directly in search results; never build one by deduction from a name
the_rule.consequence: a contact that cannot be verified is not written at all
the_rule.why_it_matters: a fabricated contact is worse than an empty one: it is acted on, it bounces, and it burns the lead
